hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ -n "$FILE" ]]; then case "$FILE" in */app/*) BIN=app/node_modules/.bin/prettier ;; */api/*) BIN=api/node_modules/.bin/prettier ;; *) BIN="" ;; esac; [[ -x "$BIN" ]] && "$BIN" --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if [[ "$CMD" =~ git[[:space:]]+push ]] && [[ "$CMD" =~ (^|[[:space:]:+])main([[:space:]]|$) ]]; then echo "Direct push to main is blocked. Push a branch and open a PR." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
